BiblicalUsage: Jirijah is Irijah, an Israelite, the captain who arrested Jeremiah. In Jeremiah 37:13, whose name was Irijah. The fuller story is told on the Irijah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Irijah belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
